claim: For either of the two opposite 13-point minimal finite models \(P\) of \(\mathbb{RP}^2\), a continuous self-map \(f:P\to P\) induces a nonzero map on \(H_1(P;\mathbf F_2)\) if and only if \(f\) is a homeomorphism. Exactly 24 self-maps have nonzero action, forming \(\operatorname{Aut}(P)\cong S_4\); an exhaustive certificate enumerates 562333 continuous self-maps in total.

integrity.claim_scope: direct self-maps of the two opposite 13-point minimal finite RP2 models
integrity.novelty_boundary: structural criterion nonzero H1 action iff homeomorphism; total map count is supporting data
integrity.proof_core: complete isotone-map enumeration and independently recomputed mod-2 homology pairing

scientific_limitations: No classification after subdivision or enlargement is claimed.
The exact self-map count is computer-assisted but has a deterministic complete verifier.

title: Homological rigidity of the 13-point projective-plane models
